d: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free ’55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

st: A Tale of Two DeLoreans - Lost Classics
d: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It’s nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

st: Kenny Roger's Family Values - Caffeine & Octane
d: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

st: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
d: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures

Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer

Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back hom

st: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
d: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impres

st: Chipper Jones' International Car Show - Caffeine & Octane
d: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.
Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

st: Caffeine & Octane - The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
d: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.
Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti hims

Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in

In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”.

Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way

st: Caffeine & Octane - Power Play: Proline's Search for 3000+ HP
d: A need for speed in a Sleepy Georgia town has engineers pushing the boundaries to exceed 3000 horsepower.

st: Caffeine & Octane - Turn of the Century Cars
d: Turn of the century cars?with wooden wheels?at 85mph?oh my!

st: Caffeine & Octane - Hot Wheel's & an Urban Outlaw
d: Urban Outlaw and designer Magnus Walker weighs in on his beloved Porsche and the legend of Hot Wheels.

st: Caffeine & Octane - Proving Provenance on a One-Off Ferrari
d: Tracing the origins and solving the mystery of a controversial all-aluminum bodied 512 BBI Boxer Ferrari.
Caffeine & Octane goes Turbo in the Twin Cities; Ferrari Drifter Federico Sceriffo finds a home in Atlanta.

st: 470MPH with Custom King George Poteet - Caffeine & Octane
d: Jaguar F-Type Project 7 crosses the Pond.

st: Art & Oddities at Old Car City, USA - Caffeine & Octane
d: Mustang Mayhem at the big show.

st: Caffeine & Octane - The Unsung Hero in the Movie Ford v. Ferrari
d: Red carpet receptions for a Koenigsegg Regera.
Kevin and Bryan throw a couple hundred horses at a 2010 Camaro pace car with a new supercharger.

st: Two Guys Garage - 2004 Corvette Gets Shocked
d: Kevin and Bryan upgrade the Federated Corvette with new suspension components.
High MPG doesn’t have to be boring.  Kevin and Bryan add a few of their own touches to a new Prius.

st: Two Guys Garage - Car Collector Appreciation Day
d: Kevin heads out to California for a special car show celebrating the spirit of the car collector.
Back to work giving our corvette a little extra horsepower.

st: Two Guys Garage - Air Flow System Diagnostics
d: With a rough running Impala in the shop, the guys check out the MAF sensor.
Kevin and Bryan give a Saturn a once over before it gets donated to Wheels for Hope.
Kevin and Bryan say goodbye to the Federated Corvette project and give a lucky Vette owner a new performance clutch.

Like many projects, this 1954 Chevy 3100 restoration has stalled. So, we’re going to help this owner pickup the pieces on this project by installing a new 350 engine, completely overhaul the front end, and bolt-on new bumpers. After were done, this truck will be ready to get wired and fired.

Sometimes Bruno will do a favor for a fellow Race Car Driver friend. That’s why Top Fuel driver Clay Millican’s old Dodge Cummins is in the shop. Like everything Clay drives, this truck is tortured and has broke a few things. Matt and Bruno get to play pit today on Truck U.

Bruno and Matt have earned some vacation time, but before they get to take a break they need to finish work on the 2012 Toyota Tacoma 4wd. The guys transform a Toyota into a Expedition vehicle that can light up any path in its way.
It’s time for the ultimate axle reconstructive surgery.We install brand new Dana 44 axles on a 2008 Jeep Jk 4 wheel drive.
Matt and Bruno install a portable bedwood kit on a collector 1946 Ford Truck and we give the truck a mini restoration under the hood.
Don’t wait till your factory warranty is up to modify your truck. We’ll show you how to add power and personality while staying street legal.
Matt and Bruno take a stock Ram and add bigger wheels and tires. A new grill and makes some new friends along the way.
If you’re not prepared to break off-road, you might as well not even play. We’ll show you what “must-have” parts you need to recover your off-road vehicle.

st: Two Guys Garage - 1967 Mustang Road Racer
d: A 67 Mustang Road Racer has a date with the Boss.  A new Ford Racing “powerplant”.

st: Two Guys Garage - Silence the Squeal
d: Bryan shows you why skipping the simple step of changing your brake hardware can be a noisy mistake.
Kevin takes a trip out to Magnaflow Exhaust to visit a couple of champion racers; Sam Hubinette and Casey Currie.
We continue working on our 67 Mustang by putting in a complete fuel system.
Kevin and Bryan get some help adding 130 horsepower to a brand new 2012 Mustang.

st: Two Guys Garage - KOI Cavalcade of Customs
d: Kevin and Willie B. hit the road to check out the KOI Cavalcade of Customs car show in Cincinnati, OH.

st: Two Guys Garage - Engine Stand Fabrication
d: Kevin and Willie fabricate a new engine stand for the shop.

st: Two Guys Garage - Evolution of the LS Engine
d: Kevin and Willie B. take us through the evolution of the iconic Chevy small block engine over the years, and show how it evolved into today’s  LS series.

st: Truck U - It’s a Jeep Day!
d: First, a Jeep Rubicon gets a power convertible top and then our YJ project gets stripped down to the frame.
After a Canyon is saved from the side of the road, Matt and Bruno find the fix in a new crate LS Engine.
Our YJ Project starts going back together with an all new Jeep tub and body. A much needed leaf spring kit and other interior accessories.
Our Canyon truck got a new LS engine, today we give the truck a brake upgrade, new lower stance and turn this into the ultimate sleeper.
Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the interior of a C20. Changing out the seats, dash accessories and door panels. We’re going from Clean to Custom on Truck U.
Matt and Bruno show you how to personalize your Jeep with some paint and fabrication.
It’s a fishing day on Truck U. Matt and Bruno take two trucks and get them ready to tow with a turbo rebuild and some towing accessories.
To sell this Longbed C-10, Matt and Bruno need to get it back to stock. They transform the interior back to a factory style bench seat.  The exhaust also gets a factory style upgrade.
Willie and Kevin take us through the shop, showing us a ton of cool stuff and how it works.
The guys take us through the Dana and Ford rear ends, showing which would be right for your application.
Kevin takes us to a race shop where he sees what goes into a high performance NASCAR team.

st: Two Guys Garage - Crank It Over
d: The guys bring new life to a Model A by getting the electric starter back into working order with a new ring gear.

st: Two Guys Garage - A Turn for the Better
d: Willie and Kevin completely overhaul the steering system of a Chevelle.
Kevin gives us a great lesson on body fab while fixing a rolled area of a fender.

st: Two Guys Garage - Impressive Subaru Power
d: WRX STI gets unleashed with some track inspired upgrades.

st: Two Guys Garage - Marine Corp Vette Part 1
d: Willie and Kevin start building a monster Corvette with the help of a new twin turbo system.
Patina C-10 trucks are all the rage. Matt and Bruno leave the paint alone on a 69’ C10 project and give it the fine details it needs to look like a finished look.
It’s back, the new Ford Raptor is here and Matt and Bruno can already make it faster and sound better with aftermarket parts.

st: Truck U - Day in the Dirt
d: Matt and Bruno find a lowrider truck that has some handling problems. So they fabrication some suspension components and do some interior work.

Line ‘em up. It’s a Chevy day on Truck U as Bruno and Matt look at a couple of bowtie trucks in the shop. They do everything from styling upgrades to common problem fixes, and as always, they give you some life lessons along the way.
It’s time to beat the drums off a 1965 F100. Matt and Bruno do a full disc brake conversation and upgrade the master cylinder and booster.
Today on Truck U, we blend Matt’s love for the outdoors with Bruno’s love for performance and styling on a Jeep JK.

st: Truck U - We don’t void warranties
d: Bruno and Matt try to find a way to void the factory warranty on a long haul Tundra.
Matt helps a buddy get his Ram 2500 Longhorn ready for it’s next camping and hunting trip. As a trade out he gets a little party time in the trailer.

st: Two Guys Garage - Marine Corp Vette Part 2
d: Marine veteran John Hayes gets the ride of a lifetime in his new C-6 Turbo-charged Vette.
Willie takes a trip to ATS and Lincoln Tech after a diesel truck goes mid 10's in a grudge run to see how they can put out so much power.

st: Two Guys Garage - I Don’t Drive What I Can’t Hear
d: Racing Legend Don Garlitts drops by the garage to get some help doing some upgrades to his Chrysler 300.

st: Two Guys Garage - Time for a Change
d: Willie and Kevin go through the steps it takes to make sure a car you are sending off with your child to college is reliable for years to come.

st: Two Guys Garage - Twin Turbo Tuning
d: Willie and Kevin pull out all of the power on a modified C6 vette.

st: Two Guys Garage - Willie’s Road Runner
d: Willie brings a Mopar out of the stable to get a much needed suspension upgrade and the tranny.
Kevin and Willie B. put some personal touches on a Wildcat UTV.

st: Two Guys Garage - 69 Camaro Suspension Upgrade
d: Kevin and Willie get rid of the tired old leafspring and replace it with a monster torque arm suspension.
Matt and Bruno have a large Truck U checklist. They have to get a Bronco Project running again. Bruno has a racer friend stopping by who needs a hand and Matt shows us the new shop purchase.
Time to get low with a K5 Blazer. Matt and Bruno are going to C-notch the frame and and this 73’ blazer while still using the factory wheels and tires.
Bruno takes a trip to San Antonio, Texas to meet the soldiers of Operation Comfort and see what makes their Bronco Weapons Carrier so special.

st: Truck U - Monster in a Box
d: Bruno and Matt put together a Monster transmission from scratch and start building the tube chassis for the Rock Racer.
Not all trucks are perfect. Matt and Bruno dissect some common Ford problems in the engine and suspension.

st: Truck U - Air Bag It Part 1
d: Bruno and Matt improve the ride quality and tow capacity on our Ford Super Duty tow project by installing an adjustable airbag system.

st: Truck U - Air Bag It Part 2
d: We finish the Air Bag kit on our Super Duty tow project and put it to the test on the road.
Bruno and Matt install some upgrades on a 2010 Ford F 150 to make it more roadworthy.
The guys work on a new Challenger while reminiscing about the Mopars of old.
Willie works out the dent on a new custom hood.
Fresh out of the paint shop, the guys install a whole new suspension and show off great new accessories for a 1969 Mustang.
Kevin hits the road to WeatherTech to find out what it takes to proudly display “Made in America.”.
Kevin and Willie do what they can to correct the frame geometry of a ‘32 Ford while installing a new front-end assembly.
With a ‘08 EVO in the shop, the guys upgrade the cooling and show us what’s happening with that extra turbo pressure.
While doing some maintenance on a 200k mile, vehicle the guys tear apart an ABS system and do a complete cleaning and rebuild of the upper and lower intake.

st: Two Guys Garage - It’s the Plasma
d: With new welding tools in the shop, the guys go in depth on the benefits of a plasma cutter and offer some great basic TIG welding techniques.

st: Truck U - King of the Hammers
d: Matt heads out west to find out what makes the King of the Hammers one of the fastest growing races in the world.

st: Truck U - See It Made-Surf City Garage
d: Bruno Massel takes a trip to Huntington Beach, California to see  a garage of Dream Cars that inspired a company.
The Chassis for the Rock Racer is almost done, so Matt and Bruno add a Speedwire System and install the torque converter.
Matt and Bruno replace a small engine on a go kart and get some help from some kids on a special project.
Bruno and Matt need to create an ultimate truck for work and play. They get a visit from Clint at ATS Diesel and find out what’s available in the aftermarket for performance.
Work continues on the Dodge Work and Play Project Truck. Today, we help the ride with a wireless air bag system and add some much needed storage capability.
Learn why a truck’s steering geometry is such an important issue to address after installing a lift kit on your truck.
What causes a misfire in your engine? Follow Bruno and Matt as they travel through a diagnostic journey to find an answer to the problem.

st: Two Guys Garage - V6 Camaro Performance
d: Kevin and Willie B embrace the efficiency and power of the new V6 engines with a few upgrades on a V6 Camaro.
A 1966 Impala is in the shop for a much needed upgrade to the original ignition system.

st: Two Guys Garage - High Mileage Reboot
d: Kevin and Willie bring a high mileage Pathfinder back to life with a complete suspension and brake system swap and a new fuel system.

st: Two Guys Garage - Get Dirty with Kenny
d: The guys get invited to take part in some dirt track racing with Kenny Shrader.  No better way to learn more about your suspension and ride than to push a car to its limits with the help from Moog Steering and Suspension.

Increasing the tire size on your lifted truck might give you better gas mileage, but you end up losing performance.  Kevin and Willie show you how gears and tire sizes relate and how to get your power back to the ground.
Want to supercharge your Mustang?  Kevin and Willie take a look at the new offering from Pro Charger.
The guys get a new diagnostic tool in the shop and find a very challenging test for it.

st: Two Guys Garage - Go With the Flow
d: Tri-5 Chevy gets a new exhaust, but only after the guys fix the modified cross-member that just wasn’t cooperating.
Matt and Bruno take an enclosed car trailer and turn it into a toy hauler with all the amenities of home.
Matt and Bruno diagnose a “no-start problem” on an ‘05 Chevy Silverado and get some help with the repair from NASCAR Crew Chief Alan Gustafson.
Whether they are on the road, or in the garage, Bruno and Matt find answers to technical questions everyday. Today, they will answer some of your viewer questions while working on a new truck.

st: Truck U - Cummins Diesel-Built to Last
d: One million miles may sound like a lot – but NOT for a Cummins Diesel engine. Today, we’ll find out what makes these incredible engines built to last.

st: Truck U - Back From the Dead
d: Bruno and Matt bring a 1972 Murdered Out Chevy pickup back from the dead by adding a new front clip and upgrading the brakes.
Today we find the limits to a stock four-wheel drive jeep. As we head out to the Eaton Proving Ground in Marshall, Michigan.
We’ll show what to do when you’re stranded on the side of the road with an overheating problem and teach the right way diagnose and fix the problem.
Beginner to Expert, we’ve got it all. We take a 2011 Ford and show how some jobs can be easier than others.

st: Graveyard Carz - Willie, Paint it Black?
d: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a ca

Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 4

st: Night of the Little Dead Wagon - Graveyard Carz
d: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark onc

When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

st: Graveyard Carz - Duster In The Wind
d: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing it’s Dash installed as well as it’s interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Ca

A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

st: Graveyard Carz - The Last WS27R on Earth
d: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration lead

The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

st: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman! - Graveyard Carz
d: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

st: Graveyard Carz - Daren Goes Plum Crazy
d: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

st: Graveyard Carz - Runnin' Down a Dream
d: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

st: More than a Wrench - Graveyard Carz
d: Frustrated by the crew's complaints that he spends all day being lazy in the front office. Mark is determined to prove to the guys that there is more to restoring a car than physical labor. Josh and Daren visit the crash site of the mangled orange 1971 'Cuda.

As the team works to complete a multitude of cars, Mark stresses over the metal dipping of the very rare and valuable ʻ71 Cuda 440-6. Tensions are high and time is limited, is the GYC crew up to the pressure?

The ghouls get the remains back from the '71 440 Six Barrel, 4 Speed, Shaker Hood Phantom Cuda and determine if the car can be resurrected. A '69 Dodge Daytona Charger arrives ready to be brought back from the dead and Mark gets a 2011 SRT8 Dodge Challenger.

The ghouls get the N96 Air Grabber installed on the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car. It's started and is ready for final assembly. The owners of '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car visit to check on the restoration progress.

Mark is hired to restore the body, paint, and suspension of a '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The shop gets some needed upgrades and the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car is completed to OEM Specifications.

The '70 Sunroof Challenger is painted and ready for final assembly. The '69 Daytona Charger is disassembled and readied to be shipped to the media blasters. Mark and the Ghoulz head out to the junkyard to blow off some steam playing paintball.

Mark and the Ghoulz use their brand new Shop Crane to lower the body of the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car onto its restored suspension and its drive-train is assembled and installed.
The '69 Daytona Charger returns from the media blaster and Mark gives Josh a history lesson on the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel Car before removing it's drive-train and suspension.

st: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Interior Car Care
d: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for cleaning and rejuvenating your cars interior.

st: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Exterior Car Care
d: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for properly washing your vehicle to avoid instilling swirl marks.

Increasing the tire size on your lifted truck might give you better gas mileage, but you end up losing performance.  Kevin and Willie show you how gears and tire sizes relate and how to get your power back to the ground.

st: Two Guys Garage - Go With the Flow
d: Tri-5 Chevy gets a new exhaust, but only after the guys fix the modified cross-member that just wasn’t cooperating.
The history and development of the café racer is explored; included are exclusive interviews with Rockers from England and custom motorcycle builders.

Dime City Cycles looks for a low buck, high yield Honda; Mods and Rockers square off in Dallas; Brian Richardson’s electric Manx Norton, and singer Billy Joel’s designs to keep the classic British café racer alive.

J&B Customs leap before they look at improving an old Yamaha; Dime City attempt to turn trash into treasure; visit a reborn Norton motorcycle factory in England, and a country lawyer and his electric bike take on the big boys.

A Harley mechanic tries his hand at building a café bike; stress levels rise as J&B look to make a technological leap; a former outlaw motorcycle stunt rider learns to race and build a café racer, and Dime City puts its 450 Honda in the hands of one of Florida’s fastest.

Former West Coast Chopper builder Jay LaRossa tries his hand at café racers; a Harley mechanic finds his way around a Honda barn-find; visit the Mods v. Rockers reenactment rally in Chicago, and J & B Motors hold their breath as the Bostrom brothers shake down their ambitious build.

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 101
d: A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 102
d: “The Century Race”: Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 103
d: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 104
d: “Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley”: Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 105
d: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

st: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 106
d: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.
